title: Turtle waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shell -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='62' rx='30' ry='24' fill='#2e7d32'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='60' rx='24' ry='19' fill='#4caf50'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='59' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#81c784'/>
  <!-- shell pattern -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='59' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#2e7d32'/>
  <path d='M 33 50 Q 40 54 40 59' stroke='#2e7d32' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M 63 50 Q 56 54 56 59' stroke='#2e7d32' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M 33 70 Q 40 66 40 62' stroke='#2e7d32' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M 63 70 Q 56 66 56 62' stroke='#2e7d32' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='52' r='11' fill='#a5d6a7'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#1b5e20'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='49' r='1' fill='#e8f5e9'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M 78 57 Q 82 61 87 57' stroke='#1b5e20' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M 68 44 Q 74 30 82 24' stroke='#a5d6a7' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='23' r='6' fill='#a5d6a7'/>
  <!-- other front leg -->
  <path d='M 62 78 Q 66 86 62 90' stroke='#a5d6a7' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- back leg -->
  <path d='M 30 80 Q 26 88 30 92' stroke='#a5d6a7' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M 20 66 Q 12 64 14 58' stroke='#a5d6a7' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
